problem : plate_with_hole a=240.0 b=120.0 t=1.0 mm, hole r=18.0 at (120.0, 60.0) mm | 2D plane stress | F=4500.0 N

reference selection (RAG retrieval -> deterministic applies() gate):
  RAG retrieval (k=3) then applies() gate -> 'plate_central_hole_tension_scf' at rank 1 (score 0.874)
  MATCHED -> finite-width plate with a central circular hole, uniaxial tension  [id: plate_central_hole_tension_scf]
    applies_to : plate_with_hole; hole centered in a strip under uniaxial tension; 2r/b <= 0.6; hole >= 0.7*b clear of the loaded ends; linear elastic plane stress
    scope_note : net-section SCF: sigma_max = Ktn * sigma_net with sigma_net = F/((b-2r)*t); central hole only, 2r/b <= 0.6; Howland's strip is infinitely long, so end effects must have decayed at the hole; small strain, linear elastic plane stress
    source     : Peterson's Stress Concentration Factors, 3rd ed. (Pilkey & Pilkey, Wiley 2008), Ch. 4 'Holes', Chart 4.1: Ktn = 3.00 - 3.14*lam + 3.667*lam^2 - 1.527*lam^3, lam = 2r/b -- a fit to Howland (1930), Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 229, 49-86; lam -> 0 recovers the Kirsch (1898) infinite-plate value Kt = 3

  peak    = 126.4142 MPa (max von Mises over 56 hole-boundary nodes)
